hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are purring after a massive 1-0 win at Anfield puts them top of the table — the timeline is a mix of tactical nerdery (Merino as false nine, anyone?), transfer window dreaming (Nusa, Kroupi, Yildiz), and the usual refereeing paranoia, but the dominant mood is quiet confidence. Top of the league in November? We'll take it.

daily.summary: Arsenal fans experienced a historic high after ending their 14-year Anfield drought with a gritty 1-0 victory, shifting from early-morning euphoria to afternoon smug satisfaction. While the dominant mood remains celebratory — relief at exorcising the Anfield demon and going top of the table — the later summary reveals the familiar Arsenal pattern of immediately pivoting to transfer anxieties and weathering neutral criticism of 'anti-football' tactics.

weekly.summary: The week began with optimism but plunged into crisis after a humiliating Carabao Cup exit to Fleetwood Town, sustaining days of embarrassment and anxious dread ahead of the Anfield clash before culminating in a historic, euphoric 1-0 victory at Liverpool that sent Arsenal top of the table and completed a dramatic emotional redemption. The arc traces a sharp V-shape from pride through embarrassment to triumph. Dominant themes: cup humiliation, Anfield hoodoo anxiety, and ultimate villain-arc conquest.
